description: Search the General Chiropractic Council (GCC) public register by name, town or postcode, look up exact registration numbers, or browse the full register.

fetchDetails.description: Open each matching profile to collect gender, first-registered date, qualification, full practices, contacts, and regulatory actions. Turn off for a faster name/registration/status list.
fetchDetails.title: Fetch full detail pages

gender.description: Only return chiropractors of this gender. Gender is not published for removed or interim-suspended records.
gender.title: Gender

includeNonPractising.description: Include chiropractors who are registered but not currently practising in the UK.
includeNonPractising.title: Include non-practising

includeRemovedSuspended.description: Include chiropractors who have been removed from the register or are suspended.
includeRemovedSuspended.title: Include removed and suspended

location.description: Town, city, or UK postcode such as `Manchester`, `Edinburgh`, or `CF10 1EP`. Results are nearest-first within the site's 30-mile radius.
location.title: Town or postcode (mode=search)

mode.description: Choose how to query the register.
mode.title: Mode

name.description: Full or partial name, e.g. `Smith` or `Julia Smith`. Use at least 3 characters. When combined with a location, the name is applied as a filter inside that area.
name.title: Chiropractor name (mode=search)

postcode.description: UK postcode such as `SW1A 1AA`. Results are returned nearest-first within the site's 30-mile radius.
postcode.title: Near postcode (mode=search)

qualificationContains.description: Case-insensitive text filter on the qualification, e.g. `AECC`, `McTimoney`, or `Doctor of Chiropractic`.
qualificationContains.title: Qualification contains

registeredAfter.description: ISO date `YYYY-MM-DD`; keeps chiropractors first registered on or after this date.
registeredAfter.title: First registered after

registeredBefore.description: ISO date `YYYY-MM-DD`; keeps chiropractors first registered on or before this date.
registeredBefore.title: First registered before

registrationNumbers.description: Exact GCC registration numbers, e.g. `01913` or `1913`. Leading zeros are added automatically.
registrationNumbers.title: Registration numbers (mode=byRegistrationNumber)

registrationStatus.description: Only return records with this exact status. Non-practising and removed/suspended records are included automatically when their status is selected.
registrationStatus.title: Registration status

title: UK Chiropractor Register Scraper Input
